triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Triage: lands in `area:ux` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p1` · Bug · size M. The grade and type stand as filed on the maintainer's order 「立卡派发」 (2026-11-24 03:05Z). This first touch was requested by repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #36743, comment 7120821905). The `pm:*` state is left to the claiming seat (repo:objectstack#3 is claiming it now), so as not to race its claim stroke.
Rationale: a lookup list that will not scroll on a phone is a UX problem on a core feature that end users hit every time they pick a record on a phone. The maintainer measured it on a real iPhone. Under the UX rule in North Star Priority rule 2 that is p1.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziG2t1d9cfRQJDrHkB

Close-out: 2026-11-24T06:52Z · area ux-C · landed in two PRs: #36844 (merge `47ed85d2`, the desktop half and the pinned footer, shipped first as the p0 #36825) and #36863 (merge `97e0f934e5e0613179a429ce9fcaa47e2d351768`, head `a8283c771d47af4cf95fd2659dad23406fced146`, L1 ACCEPT 7123978987, the phone face). Cause reproduced before code: the mobile create dialog's scroll lock (react-remove-scroll, dialog content as its only shard) cancelled every touchmove on the body-portalled popover (40 of 40). Now below the phone breakpoint the candidate panel opens in a bottom drawer (search on top, the list touch-scrolls in the middle, quick-create and 「显示全部」 pinned at the bottom; same `canCreate` gate); the desktop popover keeps the pinned footer and is modal. Nits stay in the review record: one e2e pin for both faces later; the nested-modal deferral on a slow phone (measured working). PeoplePicker's same lock is #36852. `pm:dispatched` removed.
